name: Isoamyl laurate
description: Isoamyl laurate (CAS 6309-51-9 ), also known as isopentyl laurate and carrying FEMA 2077 status, is a fatty acid ester used as a flavoring agent and emollient across food and personal care applications. Its mild, waxy character makes it suitable as a carrier and dispersing medium in formulations where clean sensory profiles are required. In food and beverage manufacturing, it functions as a FEMA-approved flavoring ingredient. It contributes to creamy, fatty, or coconut-adjacent flavor profiles in confectionery, dairy analogs, and beverage systems. Personal care formulators use it as an emollient and skin-feel modifier in lotions and lip products. In color cosmetics, it improves spreadability without leaving a heavy residue. It also acts as a solvent and carrier for fragrance compounds and active ingredients in both leave-on and rinse-off formulations. In flavor concentrate production, it serves as a diluent that maintains stability and homogeneity of complex flavor blends. This versatility makes it a staple for manufacturers seeking high-performance esters. Isoamyl laurate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications to meet the requirements of personal care and flavoring applications respectively. Bulk supply is standard for industrial buyers, with smaller pack sizes available for formulation development.
